findings.title: Keep contextual log calls observable on the test logger
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent log records. LoggerMiddleware now logs every completed request through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so an injected TestLogger no longer records those calls in its InfoLogs; they are written to a temporary logger that is immediately discarded. This breaks request-log assertions and prevents tests from observing the middleware's logging. Return the existing fake, or share its recording state with contextual children.
